But the prophecy was more remarkably and fully fulfilled in the favour which Constantine the Great, and other Christian princes and princesses from his time to the present day, have shewn to the church of Christ
though it cannot be disputed, that the grand and signal accomplishment of these predictions is yet future. Isa 49:7
